name: Jabesh
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him and smote him before the people. That is a public assassination, a public execution, and then he reigned in his stead.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
